name: Manufact

team.summary: Pietro and Luigi are cofounders of Manufact (formerly mcp-use), building open-source SDKs and a cloud platform for MCP apps and servers since April 2025.

product.summary: Manufact is an MCP vertical cloud (Vercel for MCP) designed for dev teams putting MCP Apps and servers in production, offering hosting, cross-client testing, publishing checks, submission packs, cloud inspector, and MCP-native analytics.

market.summary: Dev teams and companies building MCP servers and MCP Apps for distribution via AI model marketplaces and directories like ChatGPT Apps Store and Claude Connectors.

risks.risk: Skepticism over whether MCP is a durable paradigm or just a protocol/dead-end compared to CLIs, REST APIs, or custom agent skills.
Friction around mandatory signups to browse products and pricing confusion on credits.
Platform dependency and uncertainty around how major marketplaces (OpenAI/Anthropic) handle monetization and store rules.

founder_depth.why: Founders have been building deep in the MCP ecosystem since April 2025, transitioning from client-side agents to server-side tooling based on market shifts.

shipping_evidence.why: 10M+ SDK downloads, 10k+ GitHub stars, active open source repositories (mcp-use), live platform product with previews, testing, and analytics.

demand_signal.why: 111 HN points, 70 comments with active developer engagement, case studies, and testimonials from real teams using it in production.

defensibility.why: Built on top of an open standard (MCP) with open-source SDKs, relying primarily on developer workflow lock-in, deployment convenience, and marketplace compliance tooling.

analysis.verdict_reason: Strong technical founders with massive open-source traction (10M+ downloads) addressing a real pain point in the emerging MCP ecosystem.
would_change_my_mind: Widespread developer abandonment of MCP in favor of raw CLIs or native agent skills
Major AI chat providers building native cloud hosting and testing tools that disintermediate third-party vertical clouds
Deteriorating retention or monetization among companies relying on MCP marketplaces
data_gaps: Direct GitHub repository link was not explicitly provided in the launch post text
Exact current ARR or paid conversion metrics are not disclosed
